front: What is Render CLI in one sentence?
back: Operate Render services from the terminal — deploy, logs, SSH, psql, Blueprint validation. Docs: CLI · reference.

front: Explain the mental model of Render CLI (how the system thinks).
back: render talks to your active workspace. Interactive mode (TTY) is menu-driven; scripts/CI use API key + --confirm + -o json. Deploys are triggers against an existing service (srv-…), not “upload this folder like vercel” — Git/image is already wired on the service.

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for Render CLI?
back: local terminal → render CLI → Render API → service (build/deploy/logs/ssh) → CI: RENDER_API_KEY + service ID → deploys create --wait --confirm → curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/render-oss/cli/refs/heads/main/bin/install.sh | sh → curl -L https://github.com/render-oss/cli/releases/download/v1.1.0/cli_1.1.0_linux_amd64.zip -o render.zip → unzip render.zip

front: Given a broken Render CLI setup, what is your first validation command?
back: local terminal → render CLI → Render API → service (build/deploy/logs/ssh)

front: What are the production-safe defaults for Render CLI?
back: CI / automation: set RENDER_API_KEY (API key wins over CLI token; does not expire like CLI tokens).

front: Symptom: Wrong services listed — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Active workspace · Fix: render workspace set / render workspaces

front: Symptom: Auth fails in CI — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: RENDER_API_KEY set? · Fix: Create API key in dashboard; export before commands

front: Symptom: CLI token expired — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Idle / revoked token · Fix: render login again; revoke old tokens in Account Settings

front: Symptom: Deploy “succeeded” but old code — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Wrong service / commit · Fix: Pass --commit <sha>; confirm srv-… ID

front: Symptom: Interactive hang in CI — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: TTY menus · Fix: Always --confirm + -o json (or CI=true)

front: Symptom: Blueprint apply errors — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: YAML shape · Fix: render blueprints validate ./render.yaml

front: Symptom: Can’t SSH / empty instance — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Service not running · Fix: Check deploys; use --ephemeral for one-off shell

front: Gotcha with Render CLI: what silently fails?
back: CLI deploy does not disable auto-deploy — Git pushes still deploy unless you turn auto-deploy off (dashboard or services update). RENDER_API_KEY overrides CLI login — local shells with the env var set will ignore render login tokens. Ephemeral SSH ≠ production process — --ephemeral skips the service start command; don’t debug “why isn’t my app listening” there. Pin CLI version in CI — the install script floats to latest; pin a linux_amd64 release zip for reproducibil…

front: When should you NOT use Render CLI?
back: Don’t trigger prod deploys from a laptop as the only gate — prefer Git + required checks, or CI calling deploys create --wait. Don’t use the CLI as a substitute for IaC ownership of the whole stack — use Blueprints (render.yaml) for multi-service layout; CLI for day-2 ops. Don’t put API keys in the repo — secrets manager / CI secrets only.

front: What is Spinnaker in one sentence?
back: Multi-cloud continuous delivery control plane — pipelines, bakes, deploy stages, and rollback — Netflix OSS CD mental model.

front: Explain the mental model of Spinnaker (how the system thinks).
back: Spinnaker separates how artifacts are built (CI: Jenkins, GitHub Actions) from how they are promoted (CD: pipelines with gates). A typical flow:

front: What are the production-safe defaults for Spinnaker?
back: Rule of thumb: K8s-only + GitOps → Argo. Multi-cloud + legacy VM/ASG + rich pipelines → Spinnaker. Many teams: Actions/Jenkins CI + Argo CD and skip Spinnaker entirely.

front: Symptom: Pipeline not triggering — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Trigger config; artifact regex; CI webhook · Fix: Match tag pattern; verify echo/delivery config

front: Symptom: Deploy stuck "in progress" — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Clouddriver logs; cloud quota · Fix: Kill stuck stage; refresh cache; fix IAM

front: Symptom: Wrong version deployed — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Artifact pin vs :latest · Fix: Immutable tags; forbid floating latest in prod

front: Symptom: Rollback didn't revert — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Deployed new server group still receiving traffic · Fix: Disable bad group; verify LB weights

front: Symptom: Bake fails — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Packer logs in Rosco · Fix: Base AMI deprecated; region mismatch

front: Symptom: UI shows phantom resources — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Cache stale · Fix: curl cache refresh API; clouddriver pod restart

front: Symptom: K8s manifest stage error — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Artifact compression; account kubeconfig · Fix: Validate manifest locally with kubectl

front: Gotcha with Spinnaker: what silently fails?
back: :latest in prod — rollback impossible to reason about; pin digest/tag.

front: When should you NOT use Spinnaker?
back: Single small K8s cluster — Argo CD + Helm sufficient. Serverless-only, few functions — CI deploy per function adequate. Team without dedicated platform ops — Spinnaker maintenance will stall feature work.

front: What is Vercel CLI in one sentence?
back: Link local project, preview deploy, and promote to production without leaving the terminal.

front: Explain the mental model of Vercel CLI (how the system thinks).
back: vercel CLI talks to Vercel platform: creates preview URL per deploy, production on --prod. Project linked via .vercel/project.json after vercel link. Builds run remotely (default) or locally (vercel dev). Env vars pulled from dashboard or vercel env pull.

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for Vercel CLI?
back: local repo → vercel → remote build → *.vercel.app preview → --prod → custom domain → npm i -g vercel → vercel login → vercel link # associate or create project → vercel env pull .env.local

front: Given a broken Vercel CLI setup, what is your first validation command?
back: local repo → vercel → remote build → *.vercel.app preview → --prod → custom domain

front: Symptom: Wrong project linked — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: .vercel/project.json · Fix: vercel link again

front: Symptom: Env missing in build — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Dashboard vs preview/prod · Fix: vercel env pull; scope vars

front: Symptom: vercel dev ≠ prod — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Edge vs Node runtime · Fix: Test preview deploy

front: Symptom: Build OOM — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Build logs · Fix: Increase memory tier; optimize build

front: Symptom: Typo varcel dev — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: — · Fix: vercel dev

front: Symptom: 404 on API routes — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Output config · Fix: Don't output: 'export' if using API routes

front: Gotcha with Vercel CLI: what silently fails?
back: Preview URLs are public — don't deploy secrets in client bundle assuming privacy. Git integration vs CLI — two deploy paths; know which owns production branch. Monorepo — set Root Directory in project settings.

front: When should you NOT use Vercel CLI?
back: Don't use CLI prod deploy without CI checks — wire Git integration + required checks. Don't commit .vercel with tokens — only project ids; secrets stay in dashboard.

front: What is Vercel deployment in one sentence?
back: Git-push serverless hosting for Next.js/static SPAs — edge CDN, serverless functions, env vars per environment. Vercel docs + classic SPA refresh 404 and env mismatch debug.

front: Explain the mental model of Vercel deployment (how the system thinks).
back: Vercel builds from Git (or CLI vercel deploy) → static assets on global CDN + serverless functions (/api/*, Next.js routes). Routing is filesystem-based (Next) or vercel.json rewrites (CRA/Vite SPA). No long-lived server — cold starts and regional execution matter for APIs.

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for Vercel deployment?
back: Git push ──► build ──► static (CDN) + lambdas (region) → User refresh /deep link ──► must rewrite to index or SSR route → Next.js App Router: file-based routing — no catch-all rewrite unless custom static export. → Or set Root Directory in project settings.

front: Given a broken Vercel deployment setup, what is your first validation command?
back: Git push ──► build ──► static (CDN) + lambdas (region)

front: What are the production-safe defaults for Vercel deployment?
back: vercel.json at repo root:

front: Symptom: Refresh on /dashboard → 404 — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Missing SPA rewrite · Fix: Add vercel.json rewrites to /index.html

front: Symptom: Works locally, env undefined in prod — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Var not set for Production · Fix: Dashboard env; rebuild after add

front: Symptom: API 500 only on Vercel — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Function timeout; edge vs node runtime · Fix: Increase timeout; export const runtime = 'nodejs'

front: Symptom: CORS from browser to /api on same domain — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Usually same-origin — if split domain · Fix: Configure API CORS or proxy (CORS (Cross Origin Request Sharing))

front: Symptom: Stale assets after deploy — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: CDN cache; service worker · Fix: Cache bust filenames; update SW

front: Symptom: Preview URL works, prod domain not — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: DNS not verified · Fix: Fix CNAME; wait propagation

front: Gotcha with Vercel deployment: what silently fails?
back: Catch-all rewrite breaks real static files if ordered wrong — Vercel serves existing files first; rewrite applies to non-matches (usually OK).

front: When should you NOT use Vercel deployment?
back: Long-running workers / queues — use Railway/Fly/ECS/K8s (Deployment). Stateful TCP services — Vercel is HTTP-centric. Full control of nginx tuning — compare nginx SPA deployment on own VM.
